nodes.label: Frozen Phase 1 Sequence
nodes.rationale: The frozen sequence prevents higher-level event mechanisms from being implemented before a real-data Stage 2 go/no-go.

nodes.label: PARrad Validation Adapter
nodes.rationale: PARrad is isolated from the base RD plus point-cloud implementation and deliberately excludes pose supervision and claims of free-text generation.

nodes.label: Canonical PARrad Data Contract
nodes.rationale: Canonical NPZ and JSONL formats avoid guessing the raw release serialization and give all stages stable arrays, labels, timing, and split metadata.

nodes.label: PARrad Four-Token Encoder Contract
nodes.rationale: RD remains the primary representation, MD supplies a motion prior, and the fixed four-token 0.18-second update preserves the public interface and Doppler detail.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage 1 Label-Run and TBPTT Protocol
nodes.rationale: Label-run windows avoid transition artifacts and short-tail imbalance; continuous TBPTT then trains on full temporal state while detaching at chunk boundaries.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage 2 Go/No-Go Gate
nodes.rationale: Real-data semantic and conditioning evidence is required before Stage 3 or hierarchical memory; fixed-template alignment is not free-text capability.

nodes.label: Optional Gemma 3 270M Event Former Backend
nodes.rationale: Gemma is license-gated and optional; it can reuse a Stage 1 radar export, but its 640-dimensional hidden state is incompatible with Qwen's 896-dimensional Stage 2 checkpoints.

nodes.label: Shared PARrad Causal MD-GRU Stage 1 Architecture
nodes.rationale: All production PARrad Stage 1 variants share a causal MD-GRU encoder, 93 by 128 RD maps, 128-bin MD, four tokens per update, 256-dimensional radar features, and sensor-aware fusion.

nodes.label: Shared PARrad Qwen Event Former Stage 2 Architecture
nodes.rationale: Shared P2 uses four Qwen layers, rank-16 q/v LoRA, eight event tokens, 14-class deterministic captions, and text, alignment, and consistency losses over a frozen radar encoder.

nodes.label: Shared PARrad Subject-Isolated Data Splits
nodes.rationale: Every listed PARrad experiment variant consumes the same train, validation, and test manifests and preserves complete continuous subject sessions.

nodes.label: Deterministic Three-Template Event Supervision
nodes.rationale: Three deterministic caption variants provide closed-set diversity while enforcing exactly one activity label per event segment.

nodes.label: Event Former Bootstrap Initialization
nodes.rationale: The old zero cross-attention scale and unsafe recurrence blocked radar gradients and collapsed representations; a 0.001 effective scale and a 0.1 bounded update open the path without immediate instability.

nodes.label: PARrad AMP Bootstrap Scale Policy
nodes.rationale: AMP starts at 512 for bootstrap and warmup; 256 is the accepted formal scale after the joint phase showed stable finite updates.

nodes.label: PARrad Formal Stage 2 Joint Experiment
nodes.rationale: This full 15-epoch run resumes the proven joint checkpoint and is frozen as the fixed downstream base after the conditioning audit.

nodes.label: PARrad Conversion and Canonical NPZ Contract
nodes.rationale: The converter keeps sensors separate, normalizes command whitespace, requires strictly increasing command times, ignores pre-command frames, and persists a stable label map.

nodes.label: PARrad Frozen Tensor Contract
nodes.rationale: Changing the two-frame update period or four-token count is treated as a breaking public-contract change; invalid dimensions and dropout values fail closed.

nodes.label: PARrad Manifest Dataset and Collation Contract
nodes.rationale: RD, MD, labels, and timestamps must be aligned and time-monotonic; collation pads variable recordings and carries an explicit frame mask.

nodes.label: PARrad Label-Run Windowing Contract
nodes.rationale: Windowing keeps recordings separate, includes tails, masks label-transition neighborhoods, drops fully masked windows, balances tiny tails, and can reuse cached recordings between training phases.

nodes.label: PARrad Manifest Audit and Synthetic Data Contract
PARrad Encoder Four-Token Stream Contract
nodes.rationale: The encoder must emit four masked radar tokens plus semantic, motion, and frame states, preserve Doppler in early reductions, and keep sensor embeddings optional for cross-sensor diagnostics.

nodes.label: Chunked and Full-Sequence Encoder Equivalence
nodes.rationale: Online chunking and whole-sequence encoding must agree, and carried TCN history can be detached without copying its underlying storage.

nodes.label: Encoder Padding and Sensor Diagnostic Safety
Radar Token to Event Former Handoff
PARrad Stage 1 Supervision and Export Contract
nodes.rationale: Frame loss ignores padding, token loss ignores mixed-label updates, temporal smoothness penalizes switches only within label runs, streaming state is carried, and temporary classifiers are excluded from exports.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage 2 Bootstrap Training Contract
nodes.rationale: Semantic warmup trains cross-attention, semantic projection, and action supervision while freezing radar and adapter; joint training then enables the pre-authorized LoRA union.

nodes.label: Truthful AMP Optimizer-Step Accounting
nodes.rationale: A global training step may advance only when AMP actually runs the optimizer, preventing skipped overflow updates from overstating progress.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage 1 Training and Token-Warmup Pipeline
PARrad Stage 2 Validation and Checkpoint Pipeline
Continuous PARrad Sequence Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Evaluation must be chunk-size invariant, preserve recording boundaries, distinguish raw and boundary-masked frames, and report boundary quality plus subject and sensor groups.

nodes.label: Masked Pooling, Gate, and Stream-Commit Diagnostics
Stage 2 Checkpoint and Cross-Attention Gradient Probe
Open Radar Gradient Gate
nodes.rationale: A small positive cross-attention scale opens a finite nonzero radar gradient instead of leaving the radar path disconnected at initialization.

nodes.label: Bounded Event-State Recurrence
nodes.rationale: The outer gate must blend only update content rather than repeatedly adding the Transformer's identity residual, which otherwise causes linear state-norm growth.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Alignment, Padding, and Stream-Commit Contracts
Stage 2 Representation Collapse Diagnosis
nodes.rationale: Chance retrieval, rank collapse, sample-independent caption loss, false-negative contrastive pairs, and zero radar gradients blocked acceptance of the initial run.

nodes.label: Stage 1 Radar Token Warmup
nodes.rationale: Token supervision was added to make Stage 1 outputs action-dependent while freezing the validated backbone during the warmup.

nodes.label: Event Former Bootstrap Repair
nodes.rationale: The repair combines a small positive cross-attention scale, a bounded state gate, residual removal, truthful AMP steps, duplicate-label positives, and action-supervised semantic warmup.

nodes.label: Formal PARrad Stage 2 Acceptance
nodes.rationale: The epoch-14 checkpoint passed action, retrieval, margin, caption-sensitivity, effective-rank, and bounded-state gates and is frozen to avoid blind long continuation.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Scope and Frozen-Radar Ruling
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 already carried validated action signal and the dataset is small, so radar and the language adapter remain frozen through semantic warmup and the first joint phase.

nodes.label: Semantic Warmup Acceptance Gate
nodes.rationale: Warmup was accepted only after action Macro-F1, representation rank, cosine diversity, balanced class accuracy, bounded norms, and a zero-change radar/LoRA resume probe passed.

nodes.label: Joint Phase Smoke Acceptance Gate
nodes.rationale: The one-epoch joint continuation had to preserve action supervision while passing positive-negative margins, above-chance retrieval, caption sensitivity, representation rank, and bounded state gates.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Ledger Formal Stage 2 Acceptance
nodes.rationale: The accepted checkpoint passed all balanced conditioning gates; a recovered epoch-13 state excursion is retained as a no-blind-resume warning.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Physical, Semantic, and Verify Head Contracts
nodes.rationale: Physical heads use masked token deltas and physical-time prototypes; semantic difference and verification return logits; verify weights are nonnegative by construction.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Phase Isolation and Logit-Loss Contracts
nodes.rationale: Physical, semantic, and verify phases expose only their own trainable prefixes and train with finite weighted logits-based losses.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Event-Run and Transition Manifest Audit
nodes.rationale: Ignored gaps must not bridge events, recording edges are not boundaries, boundary targets are Gaussian in physical seconds, and every split must contain direct transitions.

nodes.label: Fingerprinted Stage 3 Oracle Cache
nodes.rationale: Cache artifacts bind checkpoint, config, and manifest provenance; radar state is carried across updates while oracle event state resets only at label-run changes.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Physical, Semantic, and Verify Datasets
nodes.rationale: Physical examples use consecutive updates, semantic pairs are balanced and split-local, and verification includes false proposals, shifted boundaries, within-event proposals, and short spikes.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Three-Phase Runner and Head-Only Checkpoints
nodes.rationale: Training runs physical, semantic, and verify phases in order and saves only transition heads together with the cache fingerprint.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Boundary Calibration and Single-Test Gate
nodes.rationale: Boundary matching is chronological and one-to-one; thresholds are selected only on validation, frozen before test, and test evaluation is explicitly single-use.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage 3 Transition Architecture
nodes.rationale: The pipeline orders event-run audit, provenance-bound cache construction, physical/semantic/verify head training, validation-only calibration, and one explicit test evaluation; the runtime controller owns thresholds.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Cache Provenance Contract
nodes.rationale: Schema version, composite SHA-256 fingerprint, deterministic metadata, atomic replacement, no pickle, exact dtype/shape/finite validation, and read-only canonical inputs make cached supervision auditable.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Phase Training and Checkpoint Selection Policy
nodes.rationale: Physical, semantic, and verify phases use domain-specific primary validation metrics and tie breakers, AdamW, gradient clipping, phase-local early stopping, and compact phase checkpoints.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Controller and Calibration Contract
nodes.rationale: The controller owns runtime inference thresholds, chronological validation calibration enforces a latency gate, and an atomic marker prevents repeated test evaluation.
